ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Social Turn in Contemporary Art Practice. Undergraduate Section. This course offers a hands-on approach to contemporary art practices that promote social change, including community and socially engaged art, large-scale installations, situated projects, pedagogical experiences, placemaking, public art, performance, and activism, among others. The semester's outcome will be a class show exhibiting students' projects/practices/interventions that address the question of social justice in our local communities. Seats are restricted to A&D majors. Any available seats left on December 1 will be made available to all A&D majors and minors.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art Undeclared or New Media or Studio Art or Art and Art History or Industrial Design major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
